lines.t:
A state in which the <c:ffff00>{{medal}}<c> comes off the <c:ffff00>{{medabot}}<c>
and it can no longer continue in the <c:ffff00>{{robattle}}<c>.

If the <c:ffff00>{{head_part}}<c> is <c:ffff00>destroyed<c>, the {{medabot}} is
{{knocked_out}}. It can return to the {{robattle}} if another
{{ally_battle_term}} <c:ffff00>revives<c> it.

The team whose <c:ffff00>{{leader}}<c> is {{knocked_out}} loses the
{{robattle}}.
